core_obligations: Uniform trait increments must be controlled despite stochastic birth, death and mutation dynamics. The authors isolate a small martingale remainder and apply a pathwise maximum-principle argument to the finite-variation increments, obtaining C-tightness and Lipschitz limits; viscosity identification and uniqueness then yield convergence of the full logarithmic population field.
